value.rationale: The exact behavior of an automatically generated stepsize sequence, separate from convergence of the optimization variables, was expressly motivated and left for investigation by the original authors. Coexistence of distinct prime periods and strict repulsion constitutes a structural nonlinear feedback finding on the simplest strongly convex benchmark, not merely another routine precision constant. It illuminates why empirical cyclic-looking transients do not demonstrate attracting cycles.
